problem_text: 已知$f\left( x \right)={{x}^{2}}+ax+3$，以x − 2除之所得餘式為5，則$f\left( x+1 \right)$除以x − 1的餘式為何？

已知多項式$f\left( x \right)$除以$\left( x+2 \right)\left( x-7 \right)$的餘式為$ax+3$。若$\left( x-7 \right)$為$f\left( x \right)$的因式，則$f\left( -2 \right)=$？ (A)$\frac{27}{7}$ (B)$\frac{29}{7}$ (C)$\frac{31}{7}$ (D)$\frac{33}{7}$ 〔112統測B〕
detailed_solution: KEY(1) 除法原理：被除式$=$除式$\times $商式$+$餘式(2) $\left( x-a \right)$為$f\left( x \right)$的因式$\ \ \ \Leftrightarrow \ \ \ f\left( a \right)=0$
